Zip Code 90012: 15% White, 45% Black, 30% Hispanic, 10% Other. Moderate/Low median income.
Zip Code 90215: 40% White, 20% Black, 35% Hispanic, 5% Other. Emerging income growth.
Zip Code 90015: 10% White, 50% Black, 35% Hispanic, 5% Other. Low median income.

Based on these demographic breakdowns and the current trends in urban shifts, which of these should we flag as 'high risk' for a luxury development? I need to present this to the board to justify our site selection.
